reason: The hypothesis synthesizes separate findings on lattice distortion, short-range order, and dislocation climb from single-phase HEA studies and applies them to a nanoscale FCC/BCC multilayer system, proposing a specific interfacial plasticity mechanism that none of the passages describes or suggests. It combines concepts from different papers (e.g., P1/P3 on distortion and P14/P15 on climb) into a new, integrated proposal for creep in multilayers, which goes beyond the literature.
